title: Glasnost-era Russian crashed craft, US astronaut sent to help retrieve it

tellings.quote: one story that came up was that in the early days of glasnost when Russia and America were kind of friends again. Mhm. Russia imparted to America that it was in possession of a crashed craft

plain: In the early days of glasnost, when the Soviet Union opened up and Russia and America were briefly friendly, Russia is said to have told America that it had a crashed craft, and an American astronaut was sent to help recover it. The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart tells it as a story that came up from his sources, without naming them. If true, the two rivals would have quietly cooperated on a crashed craft.
